Executed 23 pytest cases covering Auth, Dashboard, Master CRUD, Stock single-source-of-truth (penerimaan/pengeluaran/penyesuaian/transfer/opname/negative-stock guard/kartu), Notifications, RBAC (warehouse role), Users/Roles, Audit, Backup — all 23 PASSED. minor.issue: Brute-force lockout is per replica-pod: identifier uses request.client.host which reflects the ingress/proxy pod IP (10.81.23.5 / 10.81.23.6). Behind 2 backend replicas, counts split, so lockout after 5 attempts is actually ~5 per pod (~9-10 total). Recommend keying on email only, or read client IP from X-Forwarded-For.

issues: Uses browser-default HTML date input (mm/dd/yyyy) instead of a shadcn Calendar/DatePicker. Consider replacing for consistency and Indonesian locale (dd/mm/yyyy).

critical_code_review_comments: security.py: brute-force identifier `f'{ip}:{email}'` breaks under multi-replica ingress since request.client.host = proxy pod IP. Fragmentation means real MAX_ATTEMPTS is per-pod, not global.

stock_router.py: apply_delta and record_movement mutate two collections (stock_balances + stock_movements) without a Mongo transaction; a crash between them will desync ledger vs balance. Consider a session with a multi-document transaction or write movement first with saldo_akhir recomputed from balance.

dashboard_router.py + misc_router.py: iterate every stock balance and issue individual find_one for each item; N+1 pattern. Fine at current scale but should batch with $lookup or in-memory map when volumes grow.

master_router.py: `q` search only matches nama/kode; other identifying fields (email, telepon, NIK) not searchable.

rca of the issue: Brute-force lockout partial failure RCA: The app runs behind Kubernetes ingress with 2 backend pods. security.py:check_lockout/register_failed key attempts by `f'{ip}:{email}'` where ip = request.client.host. In this env request.client.host is the proxy/pod IP, and requests round-robin between two pods so counts are split into TWO different identifiers (e.g. 10.81.23.5:foo@x.com=3 and 10.81.23.6:foo@x.com=3). Neither reaches MAX_ATTEMPTS=5 in the first 6 attempts, so the intended '429 after 5 fails' contract is broken. Mitigation: key by email only, or trust X-Forwarded-For (via Starlette ProxyHeadersMiddleware / uvicorn --proxy-headers) and use the real client IP.
